classification: Root-executed real managed-app stop; independent read-only evidence/source review by verification_audit. Reviewer performed no process stop, app launch, build, test, UI operation or model call.
observedFailure: Managed SIGTERM did not terminate the actual native app for more than 50 seconds; service/VM shutdown completed but app remained.

sample.observedStack: main dispatch source -> GenieAppDelegate signal callback -> NSApplication.terminate -> _shouldTerminate -> nested AppKit/CFRunLoop wait

rootCauseInference: Direct terminate() inside a serial main-dispatch callback enters the terminateLater nested AppKit loop, while the previously queued Task@MainActor cleanup/reply cannot drain. The stack establishes the nested wait; pending Swift task starvation is a source-supported inference.
